$comment: Lyra’s drum song on the Bandstand (Q7.1, docs/specs/ISLAND-07-tidewheel-caldera.md §4): the band plays the pattern by hand, as it does every night, and it drags and thins; the player pins the pattern on the music-box drum once, and the box plays it the same every time. Her talk is the island’s lyra script (07 · From the Studio).

text.pin: Pin the pattern on the drum
text.tired: The same pattern by hand, night after night. Tonight it drags, and the last bar is thin.
text.steady: Pinned once, and the drum plays it the same every time.
text.hint1: Listen: they play the pattern by hand, as they do every night.
text.hint2: Program the pattern once, then let it run.
